source: a 3d dti but it's called fashion week and you wake up on a bed walk into your closet and pick an outfit a y2k, cute core, or emo or big puffy dresses and you have a 5 minute time limit and when the time is up you go on the runway and people around the world will vote you stars

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the bedroom and runway read as glossy modern fashion-show, or bright stylized toon?
answers.answer: Use a bright stylized toon look that fits the cute Fashion Week dress-up vibe.

answers.ask: Is the bedroom and closet one shared dressing area everyone uses, or a private copy per player?
answers.answer: Give each player a private bedroom and closet so everyone can pick their outfit without crowding.

blob:
## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No theme was stated - should the bedroom and runway read as glossy modern fashion-show, or bright stylized toon? A: Use a bright stylized toon look that fits the cute Fashion Week dress-up vibe.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the bedroom and closet one shared dressing area everyone uses, or a private copy per player? A: Give each player a private bedroom and closet so everyone can pick their outfit without crowding.
- [agent_inferred] circulation — Q: How do private dressing rooms connect to the shared runway? A: Connect each private bedroom and closet to a shared backstage corridor that feeds the runway entrance.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a bright stylized-toon Fashion Week dress-up venue. Give each player a private bedroom with a bed and an attached walk-in closet, with clearly separated outfit displays for Y2K, cutecore, emo, and large puffy dresses. Connect the private room modules to a shared backstage corridor leading onto a central fashion runway, with open voting and viewing space arranged around the catwalk. Keep the preparation rooms private and uncrowded while making the shared runway the visual focal point.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim because avatar customization and dress-up are the main activity. The shared show has Entertainment qualities, but it supports the dress-up loop rather than replacing it.

## Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, with private preparation rooms feeding a judging catwalk and viewing area. Match the Dress Up preset and specialize its dressing space into one private bedroom-and-closet module per player.

## Config requirements
Use `vignette-photo` for the composed runway and themed voting backdrop, and `social-hub` for the shared viewing and post-dressing gathering space. The private bedrooms, closets, beds, four named outfit-category displays, backstage corridor, and catwalk are scene-specific image requirements carried by the shape and components.

## Layout requirements
Place one free-text SpawnZone on the bed inside each player's private bedroom so the player begins by waking there. Keep each spawn bound to its own bedroom-and-closet module, then route every module to the common backstage corridor and runway entrance. The 5-minute timer, global star voting, and outfit selection behavior are mechanics rather than placements.

## Layout components
The venue contains repeatable private bedroom-and-closet modules, each with one bed and displays for Y2K, cutecore, emo, and big puffy dresses; one shared backstage corridor; one central runway; and one surrounding viewing and voting area. The top-level runway contains two subordinate zone types: private preparation rooms and the shared show floor. Compose the catwalk as the focal axis while keeping at least one complete private module readable in frame.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the bright fashion-show composition and relationship between dressing rooms and runway lead, while the simple corridor plan can be projected from it.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium because beds, closet displays, backstage circulation, and the shared runway must all remain legible across a multi-room venue. The theme is bright, cute, stylized-toon Fashion Week. `P0` applies because all spaces are connected within one interior venue, with no outside-to-inside transition, overhang, separate map, or procedural topology requirement.
